verdict.rationale: Zep documents per-user scoping: messages are ingested into each user's own Context Graph, and retrieval runs a user graph search. ABAC policies on API keys and UserGroups limit which context each agent and Memory MCP user can reach, which gives least-privilege scoping beyond the user level. Missing for 10: an explicit application- or tenant-level memory namespace, any documented guarantee that one tenant's data never appears in another's retrieval, and independent or hands-on corroboration of that isolation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can scope memories per user, agent, or application so one tenant's memories never leak into another's retrieval
